messages.text: Heads up, saw the notice that starting August 3 branch lobby hours shift to 9:00-5:00 Mon-Thu, and Friday stays 9:00-6:00. Drive-thru unchanged. Anyone know if the Saturday morning hours are staying?
Saturday is staying 9-12 as far as I read. The only change is the weekday lobby close moving up an hour from 6:00.
Does this affect the cash-in-transit pickup schedule at all? Asking because we sometimes line up large currency reviews around the afternoon deposits.
Good question. I think the armored carrier pickup is a separate contract, so no change, but I'll confirm with Rita Solano in Operations and post back here.
Website and mobile app both show branch hours. I'll check with Andre whether those come from a config file or a content page so we can update them before August 3. Will open a ticket.
Please also check the loan application confirmation emails. I think the template says 'visit us until 6 PM' for document drop-off.
Good catch Richard, I'll add that template to the ticket. Probably a few other places with hardcoded hours too, like the IVR greeting.
Quick reminder for anyone who does member-facing work: the new hours apply to lobby only, so Member Services will still be on phones until 6:00. Don't tell people we're fully closed at 5.
Thanks Chris. Is that written down anywhere? I'd like to link it in the data dictionary note for our call-volume dashboards, since the staffing windows change.
Update: Rita confirmed the armored carrier schedule is unchanged. Pickups stay at 3:30 daily, so nothing to adjust on our side.
